modern: Remember that just as it is a shame to be surprised if the fig tree produces figs, so it is to be surprised if the world produces such and such things as it is in its nature to produce; and for the physician and the helmsman it is a shame to be surprised if a man has a fever, or if the wind is against them.
original: Remember that as it is a shame to be surprised if the fig-tree produces figs, so it is to be surprised if the world produces such and such things of which it is productive; and for the physician and the helmsman it is a shame to be surprised if a man has a fever, or if the wind is unfavorable.
